items.name: Tetsubo
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 21, Ultimate Combat pg. 134
StatisticsCost 20 gp Weight 10 lbs.
Damage 1d8 (small), 1d10 (medium); Critical x4; Range -; Type B; Special -
Category Two-Handed; Proficiency Exotic
Weapon Groups Hammers
DescriptionA slight improvement over the greatclub, this weapon consists of a long, slender length of wood or metal whose upper half is shod with a thick sheet of studded iron. The iron gives added weight and strength to the club, while the studs are designed to crack

items.name: Scale Mail
items.description: Scale mail is made up of dozens of small, overlapping metal plates. Similar to both splint mail and banded mail, scalemail has a flexible arrangement of scales in an attempt to avoid hindering the wearer’s mobility, but at the expense of omitting additional protective layers of armor. A suit of scale mail includes gauntlets.
